question: The Madhya Pradesh government conferred the Dhananjayans, a celebrated ________________ couple from Chennai, with the prestigious Rashtriya Kalidas Samman for 2019-2020.
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Bharatanatyam.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vannadil Pudiyaveettil Dhananjayan and Shanta Dhananjayan,** also known as the **Dhananjayans**.
 
• They are a dancing couple from Chennai and perform **Bharatnatyam**.
 
• They were awarded** Padma Bhushan in 2009.** 
 
• They were honored with **Sri Shanmukh Ananda National Eminence Award in the field of dance in 2020**
 
• They were honored with the **Sangeet Natak Academy Award, Government of India, in 1994.**​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Rashtriya Kalidas Samman**__

 
 
• The award is named after **Kālidāsa**, a renowned Classical Sanskrit writer of ancient India.
 
• The **Kalidas Samman was first awarded in 1980.**
 
• It was initially conferred in alternate years in the fields of **Classical Music, Classical Dance, Theatre and Plastic Arts.**
 
• The **Madhya Pradesh** government has honoured the **Dhananjayans**, a celebrated **Bharatanatyam couple from Chennai, with the prestigious Rashtriya Kalidas Samman for 2019-2020.**​
 
 

e6:T
